name: @aspiralabs/ai
description: The Aspira Labs AI package: the agents and /aspira-* skills (groomer, spec-writer, planner, implementor, code-analyzer, pr-reviewer, build-feature, visual-verify) and the kit command that installs them into a project. Install it globally, once per engineer; it is never a project dependency.

scripts.build: pnpm build:kit && (cd code-analyzer && eve build) && (cd groomer && eve build) && (cd implementor && eve build) && (cd planner && eve build) && (cd spec-writer && eve build)
scripts.typecheck: tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p build-feature/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p codebase-map/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p code-analyzer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p common/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p groomer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p implementor/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p planner/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p pr-reviewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p spec-reviewer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p spec-writer/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p visual-verify/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: eslint src && (cd build-feature && eslint src scripts) && (cd codebase-map && eslint src scripts) && (cd code-analyzer && eslint agent scripts) && (cd common && eslint src) && (cd groomer && eslint agent scripts) && (cd implementor && eslint agent scripts) && (cd planner && eslint agent scripts) && (cd pr-reviewer && eslint agent scripts) && (cd spec-reviewer && eslint agent scripts) && (cd spec-writer && eslint agent scripts) && (cd visual-verify && eslint scripts)
